name: Cyclades Preservation Fund Grants
summary: Grants to local non-profits for fieldwork, community engagement and other projects on marine conservation, biodiversity and sustainability on the Cyclades and other Aegean islands. Non-local groups can apply with local partners.

calls.label: 2026 application period
calls.note: Page gives the window as 09/01/2026 to 10/02/2026 without naming the format; both readings ended before November 2026.

status.quote: 2026: This year grant applications will be accepted between 09/01/2026 and 10/02/2026.

applicant_types.quote: Local non-profit organizations, associations, clubs or unions, social cooperative enterprises and/or other local non-profit entities, are highly recommended to apply

geography.quote: build capacity and encourage participation of the local society of the Cycladic islands and other islands of the Aegean.

access.quote: please complete and submit your proposal via the online application form below

window.quote: 2026: This year grant applications will be accepted between 09/01/2026 and 10/02/2026.

amount.quote: Although there is no maximum funding limit, applicants should note that CPF grants typically average €5,000 to €7,000.
